sentences.englishText: New York University is situated in Greenwich Village and offers students easy access to amenities.
sentences.turkishText: New York Üniversitesi Greenwich Village'de yer alır ve öğrencilere olanaklara kolay erişim sunar.

sentences.englishText: There is a post office on 9th Street and several banks nearby where students can manage their finances.
sentences.turkishText: 9. Sokakta bir postane ve öğrencilerin mali işlerini yönetebilecekleri yakınlarda birkaç banka bulunmaktadır.

sentences.englishText: The area is famous for its popular restaurants and coffee shops that students frequently enjoy.
sentences.turkishText: Bölge, öğrencilerin sıklıkla keyif aldığı popüler restoranları ve kahve dükkanlarıyla ünlüdür.

enrichment.summary: New York University is situated in Greenwich Village and offers students easy access to amenities. There is a post office on 9th Street and several banks nearby where students can manage their finances.
